title: Production of human CAR-NK cells with lentiviral vectors and functional assessment in vitro
protocol: Thaw low passage HEK293T cells in a 37°C water bath.
Add 10 mL of complete DMEM media to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Transfer frozen HEK293T cryovial from liquid nitrogen tank immediately to a 37°C water bath.
As soon as one ice crystal remains, transfer cells drop wise into the 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and count cells with Trypan Blue.
Resuspend 1.5–2 million HEK293T cells in 20 mL of complete DMEM media.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a T-150 tissue culture flask.
Culture flasks at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Harvest HEK293T cells by washing flasks with 10 mL warm PBS, 24 hours prior to transfection.
Add 3 mL warm 1× Trypsin-EDTA(0.05%) to the flasks for harvesting.
Place the flasks in the incubator for 2–5 minutes.
Neutralize trypsin by adding 3 times its volume of warm complete DMEM media.
Harvest cells using Trypsin to prevent cell clumping.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in warm complete DMEM media.
Count cells using Trypan Blue.
Plate 9 million HEK293T cells in 15 mL of antibiotic-free complete DMEM media per 15 cm NUNC tissue-culture treated plate.
Incubate plates at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Re-seed a T-150 flask with 1.5–2 million cells in 20 mL of complete DMEM media for lentiviral titration.
Transfect HEK293T cells 24 h after plating when they are 70%-80% confluent.
Measure the concentration and purity of all plasmids used prior to transfection using a spectrophotometer.
Prepare two 15 mL falcon tubes with 4 mL of Opti-MEM media labeled Tube A and Tube B for each plate.
Add required amount of plasmid DNA to Tube B and mix gently by inverting tube 3 times.
Add 120 μL of Lipofectamine 2000 to Tube A and mix gently by inverting tube 3 times.
Incubate Tube A for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Add Tube B to Tube A, mix gently by inverting tube 3 times.
Incubate the mixture for 20 min at 20°C–22°C.
Slowly add the DNA and Lipofectamine mixture to each plate drop wise ensuring coverage of the entire plate area.
Swirl plate carefully and slowly to evenly distribute the mixture.
Incubate plates at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Warm DMEM media to 37°C.
Aspirate media from HEK293T cells slowly.
Incubate plates at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Pre-cool the SW-32 Ti ultracentrifuge rotor and buckets at 4°C.
Aspirate viral containing supernatant from 15 cm plates.
Transfer supernatant to 50 mL falcon tubes.
Centrifuge 50 mL falcon tubes at 2000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Filter supernatant using a 150 mL 0.45 μM PES filter to remove cell debris.
Add filtrate into 38.5 mL ultracentrifuge tubes.
Use cold PBS to bring each tube within 0.5 cm of the edge.
Balance the centrifuge tubes carefully before placing them in the ultracentrifuge buckets.
Centrifuge the buckets at 130,000 × g for 1 hour 40 minutes at 4°C with minimal deceleration.
Carefully remove the ultracentrifuge tube from the bucket and pour the supernatant into a 20% bleach bucket.
Blot excess supernatant onto paper towels while keeping the ultracentrifuge tube inverted for up to 1 minute.
Place the ultracentrifuge tube on ice and let it sit for 10 minutes to begin viral resuspension.
Add between 50–100 μL of cold PBS to the ultracentrifuge tube.
Start to slowly scrape the bottom using a micropipette filter tip set to a low volume (∼40 μL).
Avoid going to the second stop while scraping to prevent bubble formation.
Resuspend the viral pellet by gently pipetting up and down using the same micropipette filter tip.
Wash the sides of the ultracentrifuge tube during resuspension.
Aliquot virus into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes immediately after full resuspension.
Place aliquots containing 13 μL into −80°C freezer for storage.
Decontaminate anything that has come into contact with the virus using 70% ethanol.
Minimize production of aerosols when working in BSL2 conditions.
Harvest HEK293T cells from a T-150 flask and count using Trypan Blue.
Perform two separate counts and take the average to ensure accurate cell count.
Plate 30,000 HEK293T cells per well in a 24-well tissue culture plate.
Resuspend cells to 6 × 10^4 cells/mL using complete DMEM media.
Incubate plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for at least 3 h.
Prepare lentivirus serial dilutions following the specified protocol.
Mix each dilution thoroughly by pipetting or vortexing.
Thoroughly mix and add 500 μL of each dilution per well.
Add 500 μL of complete DMEM media to the no virus control well.
Incubate plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 72 h.
Assess transgene expression after 72 hours post HEK293T cell transduction.
Alternatively, wait 5 days post transduction for a highly accurate titer.
Harvest the transduced HEK293T cells using 1000 μL micropipette filter tips.
Pipette up and down in the center of each well first.
Then pipette around the edges of each well.
Transfer cells to 5 mL polystyrene tubes with caps.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Decant supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend cell pellet, add 2 mL of cold PBS and mix.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Decant supernatant again.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of viability dye using eBioscience Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 in PBS.
Resuspend cell pellet and add 100 μL of viability dye mixture to each tube.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark.
Prepare antibody mix by adding 1 μL of VioBright FITC Mouse Anti-Human CD271 (LNGFR) antibody into 49 μL of FACS buffer per test.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and mix.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet and add 50 μL of antibody mix to each tube.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer, mix, and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cell pellet by adding 100 μL of 2% PFA mix to each tube.
Incubate the tubes at 4°C for 1 h in the dark.
Add 2 mL of FACS buffer and invert capped tubes to mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min and decant supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet with appropriate volume of resuspension medium.
Acquire samples by flow cytometry.
Expand primary NK cells by co-culturing with irradiated K562 mb-IL21 feeder cells at a 2:1 ratio for at least 2 weeks.
Replenish expanded NK cells with irradiated K562 mb-IL21 cells at a 1:1 ratio one day before transduction.
Count NK cells with Trypan Blue seven days after the last replenishment.
Resuspend co-culture to a final concentration of 0.5 × 10^6 cells/mL in complete RPMI media supplemented with 100 IU/mL of IL-2.
Plate 200 μL of the co-culture into a 96-well U bottom plate for a total of 1 × 10^5 cells per well.
Incubate plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 12–18 hours.
Centrifuge 96-well U bottom plate at 300 × g for 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant from each well using a multichannel pipette.
Resuspend cells with 90 μL of NK cell transduction media using a multichannel pipette.
Prepare fresh NK cell transduction media each time before use.
Pre-warm the centrifuge to 32°C prior to thawing your virus for immediate spinfection process.
Thaw lentivirus containing the CAR construct and control vector on ice.
Dilute stock viral suspension with cold PBS if lentivirus titre is >5 × 10^7 TU/mL.
Add 10 μL of diluted viral suspension per well at an MOI of 5.
Place plate in the incubator (37°C and 5% CO2) after adding viral suspension.
Calculate the amount of lentivirus needed for transduction using the formula: ((cell count × MOI × number of wells)/virus titer) × 1000 = Total volume of virus needed (μL).
Obtain a 96-well plate from the incubator and add 10 μl of virus suspension per well.
Add 10 μl of PBS to non-transduced control wells.
Centrifuge the plate at 1000 × g for 45 min at 32°C as the spinoculation step.
Gently resuspend the wells using a micropipette and incubate the plate for 12–18 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Centrifuge the plate at 300 × g for 10 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant and resuspend cells to a final volume of 100 μL using complete RMPI media supplemented with 100 IU/mL of IL-2.
Pool wells containing transduced HER2 CAR- and control NK cells into a 5 mL polystyrene tube.
Wash cells with 2 mL of complete RPMI media.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Count cells with Trypan Blue.
Transfer 100,000 cells of HER2 CAR-, control vector-, and non-transduced NK cells to a 96-well U bottom plate.
Plate one well with HER2 CAR-NK cells HER2 Fc chimera protein control.
Plate four wells with non-transduced NK cells for unstained, viability dye compensation, and fluorescence minus one (FMO) controls.
Resuspend the remainder of the cells to a final concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in complete RPMI media supplemented with 100 IU/mL IL-2.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 until functional assays.
Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Remove supernatant and wash cells with 200 μL of PBS.
Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard PBS.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of viability dye in PBS.
Add 100 μL of the viability dye and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Prepare the HER2 Fc chimera protein mix by adding 2.5 μL of recombinant ErbB2/HER2 Fc chimeric protein to 25 μL of FACS buffer per test.
Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer, spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Add 25 μL of the HER2 Fc chimera protein dilution and incubate in the dark for 30 min at 20°C–22°C.
Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer, spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Add 50 μL of the surface stain master mix and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer, spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Add 100 μL of 2% PFA mixture and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Wash cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer, spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells to 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Prepare target cells for the flow cytometry-based cytotoxicity assay.
Label a 96-well plate layout with all conditions.
Transfer effector NK cells to a 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge effector NK cells at 300 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant carefully.
Count cells with Trypan Blue.
Resuspend NK cells in complete RPMI media to the final concentration needed for the highest E:T ratio.
Set effector NK cells aside while you prepare the target cells.
Split SKBR3 target cells 1:2 one day before the cytotoxicity assay, if desired.
Wash SKBR3 target cells with 10 mL warm PBS.
Add 5 mL of 1× Trypsin-EDTA (0.05%) to SKBR3 cells.
Neutralize trypsin by adding three times the volume of complete DMEM media.
Transfer cells to a 50 mL falcon tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and wash cells with 20 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and count cells with Trypan Blue.
Resuspend cells with a low volume since they will need to be highly concentrated for CFSE-labeling.
Ensure the viability of the target tumor cells is >80% on the day of the assay.
Resuspend total amount of SKBR3 cells needed at a concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL in PBS in a 50 mL falcon tube.
Prepare 5 μM CFSE solution.
Label three 15 mL falcon tubes as A, B, and C.
Add 990 μL DMSO to Tube A.
Add 2.70 mL PBS to Tube B.
Add 9 mL of PBS to Tube C.
Add 10 μL of CFSE (50 mM) stock into Tube A and vortex.
Take 300 μL from Tube A and add it to Tube B, then vortex.
Take 1 mL from Tube B and add it to Tube C, then vortex.
Add an equal volume of CFSE mixture from Tube C to the resuspended target cells.
Immediately vortex at low-med speed, ensuring proper mixing.
Incubate the CFSE-labeled cells at 37°C for 15 min.
Quench unbound CFSE by topping up with 10% FBS-PBS for 10 min in the dark.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Wash cells with 20 ml of PBS and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in a low amount of complete RPMI media.
Count cells using Trypan Blue and resuspend to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL with complete RPMI media.
Plate the effector NK cells according to each E:T ratio and top up wells to a total volume of 100 μL with complete RPMI media.
For 1:1 E:T, add 100 μL of NK cells.
For 0.5:1 E:T, add 50 μL of NK cells and 50 μL of complete RPMI media.
For 0.25:1 E:T, add 25 μL of NK cells and 75 μL of complete RPMI media.
Prepare the tumor only control wells by adding 100 μL of complete RPMI media.
Use a multichannel pipette to add 100 μL of CFSE-labeled target cells to wells containing effector NK cells and tumor only wells.
Plate one extra well with the target cells as a CFSE-only control well for adjusting voltages during sample acquisition.
Incubate cytotoxicity assay 96-well plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 5 hours.
Spin plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Optional: Carefully collect approximately 150 μL of the cell-free supernatants using a multichannel pipette and transfer to a new 96-well U or V bottom plate.
Place plate in -20°C freezer for cytokine analysis.
Wash wells with 200 μL of PBS, spin plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of viability dye using eBioscience Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 in PBS.
Add 100 μL of fixable viability dye to the cytotoxicity assay and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark.
Spin plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash wells with 200 μL of FACS buffer, spin plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Add 100 μL of 1% PFA mixture to the wells and incubate at 4°C for 1 hour in the dark.
Spin plate at 300 × g for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Wash wells with 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Spin plate at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend plate with 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Transfer samples to appropriate tubes for flow cytometry.
Perform sample acquisition by flow cytometry.
